mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE drops by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month indicates a surge in demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 3% YoY, it indicates a highly accommodative monetary policy supporting strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 YoY growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals robust consumer demand, which is a strong indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE drops > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs and UNRATE drops by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month suggests that the central bank is behind the curve in controlling inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5%.
